WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_order_net_fee_rate
  FROM per_order
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS avg_total_rebate,
  AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.mean_order_net_fee_rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM per_order AS p
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.mean_order_net_fee_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct orderslink is one group; SQLite groups all NULL orderslink values together as the single no-order group. The benchmark averages only non-NULL per-order average net fee rates, as AVG skips NULLs.
